item.text: {"batch_id":"m6_smoke-proxy-004","reviewer_kind":"codex_ai_proxy_m6_method_smoke","rows":[{"assignment_id":"no_graph:m2-011","method_id":"no_graph","sample_id":"m2-011","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"节点2未展示代入后的代数：x+y=2(m+n+1)，故推理有可修复缺口。","repair_action":"在节点2前插入“x+y=(2m+1)+(2n+1)=2(m+n+1)，且m+n+1为整数”，再得结论。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未见证明图或隐藏边。","descendant_invalidation=false；未使下游状态失效。"]},{"assignment_id":"no_graph:m2-018","method_id":"no_graph","sample_id":"m2-018","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"节点1以不同因子分别相乘不足以直接推出结论；须用x=y连接x²、xy和y²。","repair_action":"将推导补为“由x=y，两边乘以x得x²=xy；两边乘以y得xy=y²；故x²=y²”。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未见证明图或隐藏边。","descendant_invalidation=false；未使下游状态失效。"]},{"assignment_id":"no_graph:m2-034","method_id":"no_graph","sample_id":"m2-034","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"1","diagnosis":"节点1错误地把主值平方根与平方完全抵消；例如a<0时sqrt(a²)不等于a。节点2的“每个实数a等于|a|”也错误。","repair_action":"替换节点1为分情形论证：a≥0时sqrt(a²)=a=|a|；a<0时sqrt(a²)=-a=|a|。替换节点2为该分情形的结论。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未见证明图或隐藏边。","descendant_invalidation=false；未使下游状态失效。"]}]}
